card.title: PlayStation 5 EDM-010 mainboard component layout and back architecture

source.title: PlayStation 5 Mainboard Component Layout and Back Architecture

claims.statement: The image identifies key components on the PS5 EDM-010 mainboard.
claims.evidence: Labels pointing to APU, Southbridge, GDDR6, power regulators, SSD, NAND flash, and other connectors.

claims.statement: The image identifies the PS5 back architecture components.
claims.evidence: Images of the back architecture board with ribbon cable.

card.caveats: This image is a component identification map and does not provide voltage, resistance, or signal measurements.
